recentItems.title: House of Decay - Official Demo Launch Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for House of Decay, a 3D action Metroidvania platformer developed by White Box and ice_cream44. Players will enter a hellish home in search of their lost brother. Uncover secrets, fight monsters of nightmares, and survive this PSX-style adventure. House of Decay is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

recentItems.title: GTA 6's First Celebrity Voice Actor Confirms Role - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Ever since GTA 6's second trailer dropped more than a year ago, the internet has been trying to match up the voices to any celebrities in hopes of putting together the game's cast. Well, the internet was right about one so far: Stepeh Root has confirmed he's voicing Brian in GTA 6. Brian appears to be a friend and ally to dual protagonists Lucia and Jason, and can be seen in the nearly 30-minute-long gameplay preview that dropped a couple of weeks ago. In other news, BlizzCon 2026 did not disapoint, as Blizzard revealed new entries for Diablo, StarCraft, and Warcraft, among other titles. And finally, we may have found out what the title of Lies of P's sequel is going to be.

recentItems.description: Check out The First 27 Minutes of Marvel's Wolverine Gameplay. In Marvel's Wolverine you play as everyone's favorite short king as he stabs and slashes his way through tons of enemies both new and familiar.

recentItems.title: Steam Frame - Official Overview and Quick Start Guide
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the Overview and Quick Start Guide for Steam Frame, the latest VR Headset developed by Valve. Get the rundown on the box contents, the startup process, and how to get the Steam Frame up and running. Steam Frame reservations are live now, with official purchase emails being sent on September 17.

recentItems.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - Official 'Creatures of Greece' Overview Trailer
recentItems.description: Watch the 'Creatures of Greece' Overview Trailer for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, an upcoming remake of the original Tomb Raider action-adventure game developed by Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog. Players can get a behind-the-scenes look at what Lara Croft will face in Greece, from crocodiles to leapords. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is launching on February 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Witch on the Holy Night - Official Trailer (2027)
recentItems.description:
Check out the trailer for Witch on the Holy Night, only in theatres January 29!
Aoko Aozaki, an ordinary high school girl, is actually a Magician who lives in the modern world...though she is still only an apprentice. As she spends her days living alongside her housemate, Alice Kuonji, striving to become a full-fledged Magician...The girl meets a boy. This is the beginning of one young girl’s story — the tale of a Witch.

recentItems.title: Steam Frame Review – A Great All-in-One VR Headset, But It'll Cost You
recentItems.description:
The Steam Machine is probably one of the first VR headsets that can do everything right out of the box, from standalone gaming to streaming 2D games from your PC. But the high price, short battery life and some software glitches stop it from dethroning the much-cheaper Meta Quest 3.
